title: 6th NATIONAL PHARMACOVIGILANCE WEEK 2026 VALEDICTORY CEREMONY
bodyHtml:
The Valedictory Ceremony of 6th National Pharmacovigilance Week on 23rd September 2026 featured an address by Dr. V. Kalaiselvan, Secretary-cum-Scientific Director, IPC, followed by addressing of the participants connected offline and online for various ADR Monitoring Centres (AMCs) of PvPI and Marketing Authorisation Holders (MAHs) etc. The certificates of appreciation were distributed to the top 10 performing AMCs as well as MAHs.

The Chief Guest, Dr. Upasana Arora, Managing Director, Yashoda Super Speciality Hospital, Ghaziabad, addressed the gathering and emphasised on narrating the importance of reporting by different healthcare facility across the countries and sighted the cases from her own hospital.
